Grok is so much fun on Tesla road trips!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: stepfanie (@stepfanie); megjelent: 2026-11-25T02:37:20+00:00; link: https://x.com/stepfanie/status/2125418528513892403; média: nincs média]
My dad and stepmom got a Model Y Performance last week and called me from the road today asking how to create a free X account so they could get more Grok credits in the car

I’m like, what?? You don’t need an X account to use Grok in the car?

“No, we ran out of credits.”

I didn’t even know it was possible to run out of Grok credits in a Tesla. HOW MUCH ARE YOU GUYS TALKING TO GROK???

“Well, we’ve been in the car for seven and a half hours, so seven and a half hours.”

LMFAOOOO

My dad’s been telling Grok to turn the AC on and off and my stepmom goes, “I even asked it to tell me a 30-minute story about an American belle. My gosh Stepf, this thing is wonderful.”

Mind you, three years ago my dad was anti-EV. Now he’s a full working day into a conversation with his car and calling me because he wants to keep it going

Elon, you absolute madman
